dialogue.speaker: b
dialogue.text: How often do you exercise, Nam?
dialogue.reading: ˈhaʊ ˈɔːfən duː juː ˈɛksərsaɪz, ˈnɑːm?

dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: Not very often. I'm not in shape at all.
dialogue.reading: ˈnɑːt ˈvɛri ˈɔːfən. aɪm ˈnɑːt ɪn ˈʃeɪp ət ˈɔːl.

dialogue.speaker: b
dialogue.text: Well, unless you exercise regularly, you won't get in shape.
dialogue.reading: ˈwɛl, ənˈlɛs juː ˈɛksərsaɪz ˈrɛɡjələrli, juː ˈwoʊnt ˈɡɛt ɪn ˈʃeɪp.

dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: But I don't have time to go to the gym.
dialogue.reading: bʌt aɪ ˈdoʊnt ˈhæv ˈtaɪm tə ˈɡoʊ tə ðə ˈdʒɪm.

dialogue.speaker: b
dialogue.text: You don't need a gym. Try to walk ten thousand steps a day.
dialogue.reading: juː ˈdoʊnt ˈniːd ə ˈdʒɪm. ˈtraɪ tə ˈwɔːk ˈtɛn ˈθaʊzənd ˈstɛps ə ˈdeɪ.

dialogue.speaker: b
dialogue.text: Then start with five thousand. And stretch for ten minutes every morning.
dialogue.reading: ˈðɛn ˈstɑːrt wɪð ˈfaɪv ˈθaʊzənd. ənd ˈstrɛtʃ fər ˈtɛn ˈmɪnɪts ˈɛvri ˈmɔːrnɪŋ.

dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: Is walking really good for my fitness?
dialogue.reading: ɪz ˈwɔːkɪŋ ˈriːli ˈɡʊd fər maɪ ˈfɪtnəs?

dialogue.speaker: b
dialogue.text: Yes. But it won't help unless you do it every day.
dialogue.reading: ˈjɛs. bʌt ɪt ˈwoʊnt ˈhɛlp ənˈlɛs juː ˈduː ɪt ˈɛvri ˈdeɪ.

dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: OK. I'll start tomorrow. Unless it rains!
dialogue.reading: oʊˈkeɪ. aɪl ˈstɑːrt təˈmɑːroʊ. ənˈlɛs ɪt ˈreɪnz!
